# Quarterly operations report — May–July 2026

## Summary

The quarter closed with revenue of €1,233,225 against costs of €467,640, for a
net of €765,585 — a healthy 62.1% margin. The trend within the quarter is less
comfortable than the totals suggest, however: revenue grew 4.6% in June but
fell 9.6% in July, ending the quarter at its lowest monthly level. Customer
momentum softened in parallel — new signings declined month over month
(86 → 74 → 63) while churn climbed (17 → 22 → 31) — though net adds remained
solidly positive at 153 for the quarter. Support operations stayed strong,
closing 95.5% of tickets opened.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,640 |
| Net | €765,585 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% |
| June revenue growth | 4.6% |
| July revenue growth | -9.6% |

## Notes

- July's revenue decline (-9.6%) coincides with rising churn (31, nearly double
  May's 17) and falling new signings (63, down from 86 in May). Worth
  investigating before it compounds.
- Data quality flag: June's cost line items sum to €158,540, but the monthly
  report states a total of €158,240 — a €300 discrepancy. Quarterly costs
  above use the stated monthly totals; the June figure should be reconciled.
- Costs were otherwise stable across the quarter (~€151k–158k/month), with
  payroll the dominant line throughout.
- Support volume fell in July (298 tickets opened, the lowest of the quarter)
  while close rates stayed high — the team is keeping pace comfortably.
